change: Port B04350 effect reader with count/bypass/seven-byte records, zero-ID suppression, boolean normalization, skipped reserved byte and original error short-circuit followed by mask update. Mask setter native status is deliberately not the reader status.

Port B00770 slot bound31, allocation failure52, exact AFDDE0 cache initialization preserving reserved padding, unchanged slot suppression and ordered required callbacks. Port AFFBD0 low8 mask/cache flags and mandatory target application.

Connect BankBackend to bank Effects stage and TargetBackend to actual qualified root/identified target flag consumer. Expose raw cache to notification inputs; rename notification Cache.counts to effect_ids.

validation.comparison: Exact200-byte Bus,36-byte cache/padding, reader result, consumed pointer/remaining and allocate/change/slot/mask order. Whole bank also checks roots, control-list entries/raw words and loader-stage order including allocation and later stage errors. Converted notification IDs/flags checked against native cache bytes.

interfaces: Effects reference executes actual B04350/B00770/AFFBD0/AFDDE0, Bus class virtual38 and B03740/B0D140/B0D1A0. Allocation and virtualCC/84/DC callbacks are explicit adapters; target registries are empty.
Whole bank adds actual B044E0/B02430 with property/RTPC/state/position interfaces consuming zero bytes; constructed payload is not a complete native bank.
Source mask preparation executes actual virtualDC B041B0 without result adapter, comparing whole200-byte Bus and20-byte source.
findings: Cache constructor initializes each slot first two bytes and resource ID, plus byte32, while preserving reserved padding bytes.
Mask value0 with absent cache does not allocate or notify; existing cache still updates/calls callbacks even when flags are unchanged.
B041B0 source flag formula is (old & ~low8(mask)) | low8(value), so value bits outside mask survive. Cache AFFBD0 additionally masks value.
limits: Actual virtualCC B03D40, virtual84 B04B80 and virtualDC B041B0 bodies remain to port/connect; runtime changes they cause are not simulated by success-default production implementations. Snapshot callbacks exist only in test modules.
Bank composition does not consume actual property/RTPC/state/position formats and does not prove a complete normal bank load.
Target application with populated voices already qualified separately; effect-prefix references currently use empty native target registries.
Cache notification conversion is a snapshot bridge, not normal shared resource ownership. Factory, binding/smoothing, admission, refcounts and DSP/device output remain open.
No new normal-client/audible-output or full-game acceptance.
